jobs.description: The Professorship of Environmental Economics at the Technical University of Munich (TUM), CampusWeihenstephan, invites applications for a PhD position in Economics within the research project WETTER (Water Efficiency through Technology, Targeting, and Experimental Research), funded by the Joachim Herz Prize 2026.
